source: Hulme, A. (1982) "The wave forces acting on a floating hemisphere undergoing forced periodic oscillations", J. Fluid Mech. 121, 443-463: exact (series) solution, heave. Values as tabulated in LHEEA/Hulme_Heaving_Sphere, comparison/HulmeResult.dat (github.com/LHEEA/Hulme_Heaving_Sphere).
note: floating hemisphere radius a, deep water; a33 = A33/(rho*V), b33 = B33/(rho*V*omega) with V = 2/3*pi*a^3; ka = omega^2 a/g; ka = 0 is the zero-frequency limit
